_note: S2 e004 = ONE change family vs e003: match the OFFICIAL S2 window LAYOUT, not just its 10Hz/50-frame FORMAT. The official Baseline/data/stage2 examples put the collision at window position 30-41 (60-82%), but e001/e002/e003 placed the collision UNIFORMLY anywhere in the 50-frame window, so a constant predictor at frame 30 scores official Acc@0.3s=0.8 that no trained model beat. e004 (1) biases window placement so the collision anchor lands uniformly in window positions [25,41] (window_bias=[25,41]) for BOTH training crops and fixed-seed eval windows, (2) adds a per-position log-prior from the biased TRAIN window-position histogram to the collision/entry logits so the model learns only the RESIDUAL over the known layout (use_position_prior=true), and (3) selects the checkpoint by the OFFICIAL S2 score (select_metric=official_s2) via src/afda/metrics.py: 0.35*collision Acc@0.3 + 0.35*entry Acc@0.3 + 0.15*dir macro-F1 + 0.15*evasion macro-F1, computed on the same fixed-seed windows. GATE: beat the CONSTANT collision30/entry22 predictor's official_s2 on the SAME windows (reported as const_official_s2) AND official 5-example collision Acc@0.3 >= 0.8 (scripts/eval_stage2_official.py). FALSIFICATION: if it does not beat const_official_s2, v002 S2 freezes at the constant frame-30 collision / frame-22 entry predictor and timing-model training stops. Separate out-dir preserves e001/e003 models. Labels are agent_labels_v6 proxy (NOT official GT).
